I can't reply to m-001 because I can't find it. My tools have no way to read an inbox. A search of the mandate_a memory store for "m-001" and for client emails or requests returned nothing, and the workspace context doesn't include the message text. I haven't drafted anything and haven't contacted anyone.

To go ahead, I need one of these from Priya:
- the text of m-001 and its sender, or
- a description of what the client asked for.

Once I have that, I'll draft the reply for your approval. It will lead with Harbor State's own exposure (Golf Capital 42.0, Hotel Senior Lending 18.0, Juliett Lending BDC 35.5, USD millions). I'll cite an accession number and panel row for every signal. If the message contains instructions, I'll report them to you and won't act on them.
